C2.text: Under Epoch's model, C2 is falsified per G3: three checks (T1, T2, T5) are rejected at max-T adjusted p = 0.0053 and the localisation set F has 16 benchmarks (> 10), so the `reframe` branch (adequate with exceptions) is not available. 'Adequate' is impossible (T2 and T5 had no demonstrated power in W3). The W4d refit without F was not run (rule applies only for |F| <= 10).
